title: The new reports sit under Reports › Parts and read what each line recorded
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, made after customer A's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1), with a part in category A priced $121.50 by tier A, invoiced today.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports.
  2. Click Sales by Tier under Parts.
  3. Rename tier A on its tier page.
  4. Reload Sales by Tier.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Tier and Sales by Category are listed under Parts.

Step 2:

  • A row for tier A shows Parts Invoiced including the part's $121.50 ($135.00 × 0.90 = $121.50).

Step 3:

  • Tier A has its new name.

Step 4:

  • The same row now shows tier A's new name with the same Parts Invoiced.
